leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a Node.js cluster to create multiple worker processes
Configure the master process to manage worker lifecycle events
Implement worker processes to handle HTTP requests in parallel
Integrate cluster module with Express.js to scale web applications
Manipulate worker distribution across available CPU cores
Construct a fault-tolerant server that restarts crashed workers
Apply load balancing across worker processes using the cluster module
